grouping_policy: Groups come only from scenario_id/source_group in the supplied scenario manifest. Unmatched ground-truth scenarios are original_or_unassigned. Expected counts include only files in gt_dir; groups are not paper training/validation/test splits.

metric_policy.population: Only valid, unambiguous predictions with valid ground truth are scored; coverage uses all ground-truth files.
metric_policy.undefined: A metric with a zero denominator is null. With no evaluated predictions, all four metrics are null.
metric_policy.f1_formula: 2*TP / (2*TP + FP + FN), evaluated independently of precision and recall.
metric_policy.secondary_fields: Legacy structured JSON is accepted for is_conflict only. Pairs, actions, priority, waiting times and explanations are not scored in this binary experiment.
